title: Actions Animations
description: In Java Edition, bringing new animations, visual effects, textures, and more!!
body:
Actions Animations is a Minecraft: Java Edition modpack focused on improving animations, immersion, and overall gameplay feel. It enhances player movements, mob behavior, combat feedback, and visual details to make the game feel more dynamic and responsive.

The modpack keeps the vanilla style while refining how actions look and feel, making exploration, combat, and everyday gameplay smoother and more engaging. It’s designed to upgrade the experience without changing the core mechanics of Minecraft.
